personality_one_liner: A high-performance, raw, operational field tool focused on speed, dense data, and uncompromised utility.

spacing.rule: Intentional whitespace imbalance. Exposed structural spacing. Elements touch edges intentionally or use thick borders.

dont's: No blur, no translucency. Use solid color fills and harsh borders per Brutalist personality.

screens.name: Installer Jobs
screens.purpose: A hyper-glanceable list of properties needing remedial work, ordered by schedule or route.

states.loading: Full-screen white with an oversized, chunky loading indicator.
states.empty: Stark empty state: large geometric icon (clipboard) + 'NO ACTIVE JOBS' in mono caps.
states.error: Signal red background section with mono error text and an aggressive black retry button.

screens.layout: Mechanical list view. Hard 2pt black borders on each job card. Left-aligned status pill with mono text. Oversized typography for the customer address. A visible offline/sync status badge per job (synced/pending/failed). No padding inside the edge-to-edge container, just harsh dividers.

screens.name: Installer Job Detail
screens.purpose: The operational hub for a single property to record evidence for NCs (Non-Compliances).

states.empty: No NCs present text. Usually impossible, but handled with a simple raw mono string.
states.error: Error block reading 'FAILED TO LOAD JOB DATA' in large text.

screens.layout: Header shows property details and overall progress in a thick bordered block. Below, a stack of NCs acting as accordion cards (hard borders, raw text: 'NC NUMBER + DESCRIPTION'). Inside: original photos, mandatory 'Take Photo'/'Record Video' buttons. A persistent offline draft queue indicator at the very bottom.

screens.name: Evidence Camera
screens.purpose: A full-screen, un-styled utility camera that forces geotagged overlay metadata directly onto the media.
screens.layout: Full-screen camera preview. The bottom 25% of the screen holds an immutable, high-contrast overlay block (black background, white mono text) displaying: Date, HH:MM:SS, GPS coordinates, Project Ref, and 'Location Verified' or 'Location Not Verified' based on GPS accuracy. A massive solid white circular shutter button with a 2pt black border sits at the bottom.

screens.name: Staff Dashboard
screens.purpose: A dense, command-center view for admins/employees to review field progress at a glance.

states.empty: Zero state with a mono system message.

screens.layout: Top section: 4 oversized square tiles (Active, Outstanding NCs, Awaiting Review, Completed) structured in a strict 2x2 grid with 2pt borders. Below: A dense, compact data table of projects. Scrollable horizontally if needed. Hard alignments, mono headers, and minimal white space. Clear AI assessment status badges (Pending/Verified/Referred).

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the Brutalist Mobile LIGHT personality. Use 0px border radius everywhere. Employ hard 2pt borders (color: #0A0A0A) on cards, buttons, and headers.
Never use shadows, blur, or glassmorphism. Surfaces should be flat and sharply defined.
For typography, use Archivo for display and headers, and a Mono font (like SpaceMono or JetBrains Mono) for metrics, badges, and statuses.
The Evidence Camera screen must overlay GPS and timestamp metadata in an unapologetic, high-contrast mono block at the bottom of the camera view.
Ensure touch targets in the Installer Jobs list are exceptionally large (minimum 48pt) to accommodate field workers.
Represent the offline/sync queue distinctly on the job detail screen. Only show success once confirmed by the server.
Implement the Staff Dashboard with a dense, utility-first table layout. No decorative charts—just hard data and raw metrics.
